replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics was always a challenge for me. During my studies, I struggled with it, and as a retiree, I rarely engage with it. I prefer subjects like economics and biology, which I find more interesting and manageable.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I do. Math brings back memories of struggles during my studies. Even now, the thought of complex equations makes me uneasy, which is why I avoid it. My low agreeableness and high neuroticism probably contribute to this.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven’t. I’m not very open to new technologies, and my low openness score reflects that. I prefer traditional methods for learning, like reading novels and using books.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: Well, first, you identify the equation, like ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, you calculate the discriminant (b²-4ac).
